title: Mitigating Model Merging Conflicts via Knowledge-Aware Task Vector Purification
abstract: arXiv:2510.14697v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Model merging aims to integrate task-specific abilities from individually fine-tuned models into a single model without extra training. In recent model merging methods, task vector has become a fundamental building block, as it can encapsulate the residual information from finetuning. However, the merged model often suffers from notable performance degradation due to the conflicts caused by task-irrelevant redundancy in task vectors. Existing efforts in overcoming redundancy by randomly dropping elements in the parameter space involves randomness and lacks knowledge awareness. To address these challenges, in this study, we propose Purifying TAsk Vectors (PAVE) in knowledge-aware subspace. translated_title: 通过知识感知的任务向量纯化缓解模型合并冲突
translated_abstract: 模型合并旨在将各个单独微调模型的任务特定能力整合到一个单一模型中，而无需额外训练。在近期的模型合并方法中，任务向量已成为基本构建模块，因为它能够封装微调所产生的残差信息。然而，由于任务向量中任务无关的冗余所引发的冲突，合并后的模型往往会出现显著的性能下降。现有通过在参数空间中随机丢弃元素来克服冗余的方法带有随机性，且缺乏知识感知能力。为了应对这些挑战，本研究提出了在知识感知子空间中纯化任务向量的方法（PAVE）。具体而言，我们从每个任务中采样一些训练样本，并将其输入到对应的微调模型中，以获取线性层之前的协方差矩阵，然后执行面向上下文的奇异值分解……
tldr: 该论文提出PAVE方法，通过在知识感知子空间中基于面向上下文的奇异值分解来纯化任务向量、去除任务无关冗余，从而缓解模型合并中的冲突并提升合并模型的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PAVE, which purifies task vectors in a knowledge-aware subspace via context-oriented singular value decomposition to remove task-irrelevant redundancy, thereby mitigating conflicts and improving performance in model merging.
